_note: Template unit string -> QUDT unit IRI. Every IRI here was confirmed to resolve (HTTP 200) against qudt.org, not asserted from memory — an unverified reuse IRI is the failure mode this profile exists to avoid. A unit absent from this map is one QUDT does not model; it is self-declared as a plain string, which is correct rather than a gap. QUDT models units, NOT the EN 15804 / EF impact quantity kinds — `kg CO2e` has no QUDT unit and must never be mapped to qudt:CO2Equivalent (that is a unit of a different thing, and the error an EPD reviewer catches).

selfDeclared._note: QUDT models no unit for these. Impact-assessment units come from EN 15804+A2 / the EF method; the rest are domain scales or composites with no published IRI. They stay plain strings on the coined term.
